svg.title: Pull requests fix themselves
svg.desc: A check fails. Where a command fixes what it found, such as the format of the code, the whitespace of a text file or the rules of markdownlint, the job of the check runs the commands of autofix from .github/checks.toml and keeps the files that they changed. After the checks, the fix bot takes these files as data, only text files that the commit has: on a pull request from a branch of the repository, also one of Renovate, it commits them as one commit onto the branch, and the checks run again; on a pull request from a fork, it suggests them at their lines; on main, it keeps one pull request from bot/self-heal that merges itself. What no command fixes, the PR coach explains.
